features.label: Hold native notes and maps
features.help: Keep the original game page on your left controller. Touch and slide with your right index finger to scroll, or use the right stick. B closes the page.

features.label: Full body and tracked arms
features.help: Shows your body and tracks both arms and legs in VR.

features.label: Power gestures
features.help: Trigger powers with hand gestures. Leave off to use the controller trigger.

features.label: Physical hand bodies (experimental, headset test)
features.help: Gives each hand a physical body that pushes against props and walls and lags when blocked; it never moves you. Experimental: not yet tested in a headset. The no-hand-body file always turns it off.

features.label: Hand reach clamp
features.help: Keeps your virtual hands from stretching away from your body.

features.label: Carried objects stop at walls and floors
features.help: A carried object (a tank, a crate) stops at walls and floors instead of passing through, your hand stays with it, and a dropped one is pushed clear before it falls. Turn off to carry as before.

features.label: Fingers follow the controller's touch sensors
features.help: Your fingers rest on the trigger and lift off the thumb buttons the way the sensors on Touch controllers see them (needs a runtime that supports touch sensing). Turn off to curl the fingers from the trigger and grip values alone.

features.label: Blink aimed by the left hand
features.help: Blink aims along your left hand instead of your head.

features.label: Shots from the hand
features.help: Firearms and crossbow shoot along your hand, not your head.

features.label: Stealth kills by sword contact
features.help: Touching an unaware enemy with the sword performs the stealth kill.

features.label: Sword contact damage
features.help: Sword hits you land physically deal damage.

features.label: Weapon collision
features.help: The sword collides with enemies and the world.

features.label: Impact effects
features.help: Plays hit effects and feedback when the sword strikes.

features.label: Closer takedown trigger
features.help: Choke and stealth-kill offers (and their prompts) appear closer to the guard: 0.75 of the game's reach, never longer. Set build/takedown-range-scale (0.5 to 1.0) to change it.

features.label: Faster slashes
features.help: Slash animations play 1.7 times faster.

features.label: Physical crouch
features.help: Crouch by crouching in real life.

features.label: Quest button labels
features.help: Shows Quest controller button names instead of gamepad glyphs.

features.label: Hold Y menu shortcut
features.help: Hold left Y during play for Pause, then release and hold again for VR settings. A short press during play still talks to people.

features.label: Hold Y opens the game pause menu
features.help: Hold Y opens Pause during play and VR settings while paused. Turn off to restore the old direct VR settings panel.

features.label: Headset owns the view in takedowns and scenes
features.help: During takedowns and scripted scenes the view follows your head instead of the game's spinning camera.

features.label: Keep physical head offset during actions
features.help: Preserve bounded lean and crouch compensation during head-owned actions; reset camera history when its owner, reference or action mode changes. Experimental, headset verification pending.

features.label: Smooth the camera's up-and-down motion
features.help: Landings, crouching and stairs ease the view height instead of jolting it; falls and teleports still follow exactly.

features.label: Ease into smooth turning
features.help: Smooth turning builds up to full speed over a moment instead of starting at once, which is gentler on the stomach. Snap turning is unchanged.

features.label: Darken the edges while moving
features.help: A soft dark ring closes in while the stick walks or smooth-turns you, and fades away when you stop. Head movement and snap turns never trigger it.

features.label: Sword swings press the game's attack
features.help: A fast swing with the sword drawn, or a straight stab while crouched, presses the game's own attack, and the game decides whether it is a stealth kill. Turn off for the older contact-based routing.

features.label: Readable takedown prompt
features.help: The kill and choke hint over a guard is drawn at least 25 cm wide so it can be read. Turn off for the older 7 cm hint.

features.label: Bodies move twice as easily
features.help: A carried or dragged body follows your hand with twice the pulling strength, so it lags less. Turn off for the earlier, heavier feel.

features.label: Steadier aim
features.help: Smooths small hand tremors in the aim of the crosshair, Blink, shots and powers: still hands are steadied, quick sweeps stay responsive. Your drawn hand and sword are not affected. Turn off for the raw hand aim.

features.label: Steady power trigger
features.help: Holding the left trigger to aim Blink stays a hold: a light squeeze or a flicker no longer casts it early, and a quick tap still casts at once. Turn off for the raw trigger.

features.label: Redraw HUD panels only when they change
features.help: The HUD, wrist watches, controls card, settings panel and wheel dot send the headset a new image only when their picture changed, and reuse the last one otherwise. Turn off to send a new image every frame as before.

features.label: Read the game's screen state once per frame
features.help: The mod asks the game which screen is up (playing, menu, wheel) about 90 times a frame; by default it looks once per frame and reuses the answer within that frame. Turn off to look on every ask as before.

features.label: performance mode: one eye per frame (more fps; may double on motion)
features.help: The game draws one eye per frame, alternating, and the headset reprojects the other. The two eyes then show the world a frame apart, which can read as a double image in one eye when you move or turn. Your selected anti-aliasing remains active when its per-eye checks pass. Off by default; turn it on here for more fps.

features.label: Per-eye temporal AA in performance mode
features.help: Allows temporal AA with separate history and previous camera state for each eye in performance mode. Applies to Game TAA, FSR and DLSS. Falls back to spatial AA if native ownership checks fail.

features.label: Eye images carry the head pose they were drawn from
features.help: The game draws a frame one step behind the mod's camera update, so each eye image is sent to the headset with the head pose it was actually drawn from (the headset corrects the rest of the head motion itself). Turn off to send the newer pose as before: the world could lag and judder on head turns and while walking.

features.label: Right eye gets FSR/DLSS from the first frame
features.help: FSR and DLSS run on the right eye as soon as a level starts. Before, the right eye could fall back to the game's own TAA over the left eye's history until a private copy of that history was made: ghosting in the right eye for up to a minute. Turn off to restore the old wait.

features.label: Grab with the grip button alone
features.help: Squeezing the grip next to something grabbable picks it up without the trigger; blocking, doors, levers, loot and drawing a gun from the hip still work as before. Turn off to need the old grip-and-trigger combination.

features.label: Talk and pickpocket on the trigger
features.help: Aiming at a person's Talk or Pickpocket prompt, press that hand's trigger to talk or take from their pocket; the grip still opens doors, holds keyholes, takes loot and chokes, so it no longer talks or pickpockets by accident. Holding the grip at a keyhole now keeps the peek. Turn off to put talk and pickpocket back on Y and the grip.

features.label: Palm picks loot and props
features.help: The hand picks what to grab, or which part of a body, by where your palm is, instead of the older nearest-object pick. Turn off for the older pick.

features.label: Corpses slip instead of dropping
features.help: A body you carry slips back toward your hand when it snags on something instead of being dropped at once. Turn off to drop it the old way after a hard snag.

features.label: Hold living guards and civilians
features.help: Grab a living guard or civilian: he stumbles and notices you, and a hard pull ragdolls him while you keep a limb. Chokes, takedowns and talking still take priority. Turn off to leave living people alone (the fist pull stays).

features.label: Fingers stop on surfaces
features.help: Your fingers rest on tables, shelves and paper instead of passing through them. Turn off to let them curl through.

features.label: Torso hold carries a body
features.help: Holding a body by the torso for about half a second puts it on your shoulder (the game's carry); letting go drops it. Limbs, head and a quick grab still drag. Turn off to always drag.

features.label: Grip eases in
features.help: Your fingers ease into a grip over a moment instead of snapping shut. Turn off to snap straight to the grip pose.

features.label: Throw grenades by hand swing
features.help: A grenade leaves your left hand with the speed and direction of your swing. Turn off to throw it the game's normal way.

features.label: Place mines and razors by left-hand aim
features.help: Mines and spring razors are placed where your left hand points while the left trigger is held. Turn off to aim them with your head.

features.label: Pre-rendered videos show flat at once
features.help: Recorded videos go straight to the flat screen instead of a moment of black first. Turn off to wait the old way.

features.label: Hold A or X to skip a cutscene
features.help: Holding A or X for about 0.6 seconds skips a cutscene or video that can be skipped. Turn off for no skip shortcut.

features.label: No black bars in 3D cutscenes
features.help: Hides the black cinema bars the game draws in 3D cutscenes, in both eyes. Turn off to show them.

features.label: Sprint hand tracking repair
features.help: Keeps player motion separate from hand motion so the hands do not repeatedly lag and catch up during sprinting. Turn off to compare the previous tracking.

features.label: Selected AA in performance mode
features.help: Uses your selected FSR, DLSS or Game TAA mode while alternating eyes. Falls back to spatial AA if per-eye temporal ownership fails. Enabled by default.

features.label: Hand and prop depth repair (experimental)
features.help: Applies world depth to hands and carried props so nearer surfaces can hide them.

features.label: Capture graphics diagnostics
features.help: Saves a short graphics trace for troubleshooting once gameplay is ready. Off by default; this does not enable DLSS.

features.label: Dual wield (experimental, headset test)
features.help: Either hand can hold the sword or the gun, grenade or power. Draw the sword over either shoulder and the gun from the hip with either hand. Hold X for the left hand's weapon wheel and A for the right hand's; push the right stick up to jump (hold it up to swim up or climb); B drinks a health elixir. The wheel is drawn at the hand that opened it; point at what you want.

features.label: Record frame timing and controller diagnostics
features.help: Writes per-frame timing and controller trace files for troubleshooting. Turn off to measure performance without the recording cost.

features.label: Temporal/DLSS diagnostic capture
features.help: Captures extra temporal anti-aliasing data for troubleshooting. Off by default; it costs performance.

features.label: Skip the game intro movies
features.help: While the game starts, the launcher taps a key so the logo movies are skipped and you reach the title menu sooner. Applies to the next Launch VR. Untested on a headset: if the intro still plays, leave it off.
